steps: Go to the official Chase page https://creditcards.chase.com/travel-credit-cards/united/club-infinite and confirm the current new-cardmember offer and $695 annual fee before applying.
Apply online and get approved (excellent credit typically required; expect a hard inquiry).
Within the first 3 months from account opening, spend $5,000 on purchases you were ALREADY going to make — groceries, gas, bills, planned travel. Do not manufacture spend.
Optional: add an authorized user within the first 3 months to earn the extra 10,000 bonus miles (total up to 90,000); their charges hit your bill, so only add someone you trust.
Pay the statement balance in full every month — at ~20%+ APR, any carried balance eats the bonus fast.
Watch your MileagePlus account after you qualify; miles should post to your United account within weeks — if not, call the number on the back of the card.
Before the year-two fee hits, decide: keep the card only if the United Club membership + perks outweigh $695/year, otherwise downgrade or cancel.
Timing: bonus posts to your MileagePlus account after qualifying purchases post; Chase does not state a fixed window on the captured page — allow up to 8 weeks.
